verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation, compliance and bookkeeping service, not an AI agent or assistant that would consume tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product agent or any MCP client capability that would make this axis apply. The only nearby items, 'AI-powered, human-managed bookkeeping' and 'Advanced API integrations', are not MCP tool consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
